recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片細胞密度明顯高於年齡預期（約80–90%），只剩散在的小脂肪空泡，巨核細胞分布其間；在此倍率下無法確切辨認單核球，需搭配周邊血單核球增多與CD14/CD163染色才能支持慢性骨髓單核球性白血病（CMML）。
features: Hypercellular marrow (approximately 80–90%) with only small scattered fat vacuoles
Dense mixed hematopoietic population with myeloid predominance
Megakaryocytes scattered throughout, some small with hypolobated nuclei
Bony trabecula at top and a small vessel at upper left; no fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates evident
Monocytes cannot be reliably distinguished from other myeloid cells at this low magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section at low power shows a hypercellular marrow for age, with cellularity of approximately 80–90% and only small residual fat spaces. The hematopoietic population is dense with myeloid predominance, and megakaryocytes are scattered, including some small forms. No fibrosis, granulomas, or lymphoid aggregates are seen at this magnification, and individual monocytes cannot be confidently identified. In conjunction with persistent peripheral monocytosis, increased marrow monocytes, dysplasia, and <5% blasts, the findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML-1).

ddx.vs: aCML shows a similarly hypercellular granulocytic marrow but lacks significant monocytosis (<10% monocytes) and has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with circulating precursors.
CML can show relative monocytosis but has basophilia, numerous small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and clonal markers (e.g., TET2, SRSF2, ASXL1) and flow shows a normal classical monocyte fraction below 94%.
PMF or PV with monocytosis shows characteristic large atypical MPN-type megakaryocyte clusters and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation with prior MPN features.
